router.description: Redirects an incoming echo to the router's arrow direction. The cell itself remains empty; only the outgoing echo changes direction.
router.notes: The four glyph variants encode the four cardinal directions. The runtime picks the glyph based on placement UI, but the rewrite is the same shape.

fork.description: Splits one incoming echo into two outgoing echoes in fixed directions relative to arrival.
fork.notes: The default fork on an eastbound echo emits N and S. Rotated variants adjust accordingly.

merge.description: Two echoes arriving on the same tick coalesce into one outgoing echo. A single echo arriving alone is consumed silently.
merge.notes: This is the timing gate of the game. Every non-trivial chamber uses it.

filter.description: Only echoes whose arrival direction matches the filter's phase pass through; the rest are consumed.
filter.notes: Phase is derived from arrival direction. N↔S and E↔W are opposite phases.

delay.description: Holds an incoming echo for N ticks (default 1), then re-emits it in the same direction.
delay.notes: The N in `after N` is the tile's configured delay; default configuration is 1.

cancel.description: Opposite-direction arrivals on the same tick annihilate. Same-direction arrivals pass through unchanged.
cancel.notes: This is how the game teaches parity.

resonate.rewrite_form: A -> B if hits >= 2 within window
resonate.description: Only lights after receiving at least two echoes within a sliding window (default 3 ticks). Then emits east.
resonate.notes: The window and threshold are configurable in the tile parameters; the shipped default is 2 hits within 3 ticks.

phase_semantics.definition: Phase of an arriving echo equals its arrival direction. Two arrivals are 'opposite phase' iff their directions are (N,S) or (E,W).
phase_semantics.why: Deriving phase from direction removes the need for authored phase per-source. Every rewrite involving phase (filter, cancel) reads from the direction the echo already carries.
